WhatsApp's Username Feature Raises Concerns Over Impersonation and Identity Spoofing

The Indian government has asked WhatsApp to halt its rollout of a new username feature due to concerns that it could facilitate impersonation and identity spoofing. The feature, which allows users to choose their own usernames, has raised questions about the potential risks to user privacy and security.
